scientific_integrity: Radial disintegration and all-body inequalities are proved analytically. Finite quadrature checks are corroborative rather than proofs of universal quantifiers. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Affine degree only. The pointwise ordering holds for centered bodies; strict norm separation is established for centrally symmetric bodies. No higher-degree or unrelated boundary sampling claim; priority remains subject to independent bibliographic review.
title: Uniform volume has strictly larger affine projection amplification than cone-boundary sampling
